title: Managed Object Storage
notes: Managed object-storage SDKs are provider-specific and make the storage choice visible, though S3 has notable mindshare.

provider_tools.label: Amazon S3
provider_tools.notes: Managed object storage with provider-specific SDK and auth flow.

provider_tools.label: Google Cloud Storage
provider_tools.notes: Managed object storage with Google-specific bucket/blob client classes.

provider_tools.label: Azure Blob Storage
provider_tools.notes: Managed object storage with Azure-specific blob clients and SAS generation.

provider_tools.label: Alibaba OSS
provider_tools.notes: Managed object storage with OSS-specific client and signing flow.

provider_tools.label: IBM Cloud Object Storage
provider_tools.notes: Managed object storage through IBM's S3-compatible SDK surface.
